message: Hi, I'm a student with a hadoop certification background. My overall academic average is 80.3% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in IOT and testing. I want to become a Web Developer. My family can afford at most about USD 1200 per year. I live in Delhi. I cannot leave my city. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.
explanation:
This MSc in Software Quality Engineering directly addresses your interest in testing and is located in Delhi with a low tuition cost ($650), making it highly feasible. While its placement rate (60%) is moderate, the focus on software quality aligns well with becoming a Web Developer.

The MSc Big Data Analytics program offers strong job prospects in Delhi (median salary $10,021) and has a manageable tuition fee ($800). Although focused on data science, the analytical skills gained are highly transferable to modern web development roles.

MSc Cloud Computing is an excellent choice for a Web Developer aiming for high employability in Delhi. With low tuition ($950) and a strong industry focus (networking/cloud), it complements your existing background and offers good job potential.

This MCA program covers both software engineering and data analytics, making it a comprehensive option for aspiring Web Developers. The tuition ($1350) is within budget, and the curriculum provides a solid foundation in core development skills.
